author: WILLIAM SHAKESPEARE

phrase: OPPORTUNITY OFTEN COMES DISGUISED AS HARD LABOR, WHICH IS WHY SO FEW RECOGNIZE IT.
author: ANN LANDERS

phrase: PATIENCE WITH FAMILY IS KIND LOVE, PATIENCE WITH ALL OTHERS IS REQUISITE RESPECT.
author: PROVERB

phrase: QUIET CONVERSATIONS WITH ONE'S SOUL YIELD THE RICHEST FRUITS OF SOUND UNDERSTANDING.
author: PROVERB

phrase: REPUTATION IS WHAT MEN THINK YOU ARE; CONSCIENCE IS WHAT GOD AND ANGELS KNOW YOU BE.
author: THOMAS PAINE

phrase: SINCERITY AND ENTHUSIASM CAN CONQUER MOUNTAINS WHERE MERE BRILLIANCE OFTEN STUMBLES.

phrase: THE ART OF BEING WISE IS THE ART OF KNOWING EXACTLY WHAT TO OVERLOOK IN CONTROVERSY.

phrase: UNSELFISH DEVOTION TO COMMON WELL-BEING IS THE HIGHEST CROWN OF MORAL EXCELLENCE.

phrase: VICTORY GAINED BY COERCION IS AKIN TO DEFEAT, FOR IT LACKS THE GENUINE CONSENT OF HEARTS.

phrase: WISDOM EXCEEDS WEALTH AS THE SUN'S GLOWING MAJESTY OUTSHINES THE FAINTEST FLICKERING CANDLE.

phrase: YOUTH MAY BE BLIND TO THE FUTURE, BUT AGE OFTEN TURNS BLIND EYES UPON THE LIVING PRESENT.
author: PROVERB

phrase: A CRITIC IS A LEGLESS TRAVELER WHO INSTRUCTS SWIFT RUNNERS HOW BEST TO SPRINT FORWARD.
author: CHANNING POLLOCK

phrase: BEWARE OF FALSE KNOWLEDGE; IT IS IMMENSELY MORE DANGEROUS TO REASON THAN OUTRIGHT IGNORANCE.

phrase: CHARACTER IS LIKE A SOLID TREE AND REPUTATION LIKE ITS SHADOW CAST BENEATH THE MIDDAY SUN.

phrase: DIGNITY DOES NOT CONSIST IN POSSESSING HIGH HONORS, BUT IN TRULY CONSCIOUS MERIT OF THEM.
author: ARISTOTLE

phrase: ENVY EATS NOTHING EXCEPT ITS OWN FRAIL HEART, CORRODING THE VESSEL IN WHICH IT IS STORED.
author: PROVERB

phrase: FRIENDSHIP IS A SINGLE ENERGETIC SOUL DWELLING HARMONIOUSLY WITHIN TWO SEPARATE BODIES.
author: ARISTOTLE

phrase: GENIUS IS ONE PERCENT INVENTIVE INSPIRATION AND NINETY-NINE PERCENT RIGOROUS PERSPIRATION.

phrase: HE WHO CANNOT BE A GOOD FOLLOWER CANNOT BE A TRULY INSPIRING COMMANDER OR LEADER.
author: ARISTOTLE

phrase: IMAGINATION IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN DRY KNOWLEDGE, FOR KNOWLEDGE IS STRICTLY LIMITED.

author: BENJAMIN FRANKLIN

phrase: KINDNESS IS A CURRENCY WHICH THE DEAF CAN HEAR CLEARLY AND THE BLIND CAN PLAINLY BEHOLD.
author: MARK TWAIN

phrase: LOVING SACRIFICE IS THE HIGHEST TESTAMENT OF DEVOTION KNOWN THROUGHOUT RECORDED HISTORY.
author: PROVERB

phrase: MAGNIFICENT RESULTS ARE NEVER PRODUCED EXCEPT BY COMMITTING EXTENSIVE PATIENT INDUSTRY.

phrase: NOTHING IN LIFE IS TO BE FEARED; IT IS ONLY TO BE PATIENTLY AND THOROUGHLY UNDERSTOOD.

phrase: OBSTACLES ARE THOSE FRIGHTFUL THINGS YOU SEE WHEN YOU TAKE YOUR FOCUSED EYES OFF THE GOAL.
author: HENRY FORD

phrase: PRIDE GOETH BEFORE DESTRUCTION, AND A HAUGHTY SPIRIT SWELLS BEFORE A DISASTROUS FALL.
author: PROVERB

phrase: QUARRELS WOULD NOT LAST SO LONG IF SILLY FAULT WERE ONLY UPON ONE DISPUTING PARTY.
author: FRANCOIS DE LA ROCHEFOUCAULD

phrase: REAL INTEGRITY IS DOING THE RIGHT THING EVEN WHEN KNOWING THAT NOBODY IS WATCHING YOU.
author: C. S. LEWIS

phrase: SOMETIMES THE QUESTIONS ARE COMPLICATED AND THE GENUINE ANSWERS ARE BEAUTIFULLY SIMPLE.
author: DR. SEUSS

phrase: THE ONLY COMPREHENSIVE MISTAKE IN LIFE IS THE ONE FROM WHICH WE DERIVE ZERO WISDOM.
author: HENRY FORD

phrase: UNJUST CONDEMNATION REBOUNDS WITH DOUBLE WEIGHT UPON THE HEAD OF THE WRONGFUL ACCUSER.
author: PROVERB
